apple.storage_tip: Store apples in the refrigerator crisper drawer. Keep separate from other produce as apples release ethylene gas which accelerates ripening.
apple.safety_guideline: Avoid consuming apples with deep bruising, mushy soft spots, internal core rot, or fungal discoloration.

banana.storage_tip: Store bananas at room temperature in a well-ventilated fruit basket or hanger. Wrap crown in plastic to retard ethylene. Refrigerate only once fully ripe.
banana.safety_guideline: Discard bananas showing liquid leakage, sour off-odors, or grey mold around the stem or peel.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Vitamin B6, Vitamin C, Potassium, Magnesium

orange.storage_tip: Store oranges at cool room temperature for up to a week, or in the refrigerator crisper drawer for up to 3-4 weeks in breathable mesh.
orange.safety_guideline: Discard if soft, waterlogged, or if white/blue-green powdery penicillium mold appears on the peel.

nutrition.key_vitamins: High Vitamin C, Folate, Thiamine, Calcium

tomato.storage_tip: Store whole tomatoes stem-side down at room temperature away from direct sunlight. Refrigeration dulls flavor enzymes and creates mealy texture.
tomato.safety_guideline: Inspect for surface breaks, skin collapse, black rot lesions, or foul fermented odor.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Lycopene, Vitamin C, Potassium, Vitamin K

potato.storage_tip: Keep in a cool, dark, dry, and well-ventilated place like a pantry. Never refrigerate and keep separate from onions.
potato.safety_guideline: Never consume potatoes with extensive green patches (solanine toxicity), soft rot, or bad odor.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Vitamin C, Vitamin B6, Potassium, Manganese

cucumber.storage_tip: Wrap dry cucumbers in paper towels to absorb surface moisture and store in the warmest part of your refrigerator.
cucumber.safety_guideline: Discard if skin feels slimy, rubbery, yellowed, or if sunken soft depressions have formed.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Vitamin K, Potassium, Magnesium, High Hydration

bitter_gourd.storage_tip: Wrap in breathable paper towels and store inside a ventilated bag in the crisper drawer for up to 4-5 days.
bitter_gourd.safety_guideline: Discard if the flesh turns mushy, slimy, or starts yellowing/orange splitting with offensive odor.

onion.storage_tip: Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated basket away from direct sunlight. Do not store near potatoes.
onion.safety_guideline: Discard onions showing black mold (Aspergillus niger), neck rot, or mushy outer layers.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Quercetin, Vitamin C, Vitamin B6, Sulfur compounds

carrot.storage_tip: Remove green tops, keep unwashed in a perforated plastic bag in the refrigerator crisper drawer.
carrot.safety_guideline: Discard if limp, rubbery, slimy, or exhibiting white blush bacterial rot.

mango.storage_tip: Keep at room temperature until ripe and fragrant. Once ripe, refrigerate for up to five days.
mango.safety_guideline: Inspect for sap burn, fermented alcoholic scent, or deep skin blackening.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Folate, Potassium

grapes.storage_tip: Store unwashed in their original ventilated container in the refrigerator crisper drawer.
grapes.safety_guideline: Discard clusters with grey fuzz (Botrytis cinerea mold) or leaking fermented juice.

broccoli.storage_tip: Keep in the crisper drawer with loose wrapping to allow air circulation. Avoid dampness.
broccoli.safety_guideline: Discard if florets turn yellowish-brown, develop a pungent odor, or show slippery stem rot.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Vitamin C, Vitamin K, Sulforaphane, Folate

rice.storage_tip: Refrigerate cooked rice within 2 hours. Consume within 3 to 4 days. Reheat until steaming hot.
rice.safety_guideline: Never eat cooked rice left at room temperature overnight due to heat-stable Bacillus cereus toxins.

bread.storage_tip: Store in a cool, dry breadbox or freeze sliced bread. Avoid refrigeration as it accelerates staling.
bread.safety_guideline: Do not eat bread with visible mold patches; mold spores penetrate deeply into porous baked goods.

pizza.storage_tip: Refrigerate in an airtight container within two hours. Consume within 3 to 4 days.
pizza.safety_guideline: Discard if cheese develops an uncharacteristic sour odor or if toppings appear discolored.

nutrition.key_vitamins: Calcium, Protein, Lycopene from tomato base

sandwich.storage_tip: Keep wrapped in wax paper or foil in the refrigerator. Consume within 24 to 48 hours.
sandwich.safety_guideline: Perishable condiments (mayonnaise, eggs, meats) must be kept strictly below 40°F (4°C).
